observations: Two photos show a large open container/truck bed filled with many car engines/engine parts laid out in rows.
The engines/parts appear disassembled (cylinders/heads/blocks and accessories visible), not a single complete vehicle.
No clear readable plate, VIN, engine code, or model year markings are visible in the photos.
The container has rust and paint wear; some parts look mixed together (multiple engine types/variants possible).

claims.evidence: Photos show mixed engine parts; no RX350-specific identification (engine code/VIN/label) is readable.
No ES350-specific identification is readable in the photos.
No IS250-specific identification is readable in the photos.
No Camry-specific identification is readable in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong exact engine/variant (e.g., different engine codes, displacement, or Lexus vs Toyota variants) mixed in the container.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/label on the block (or a photo of the full engine with the stamped code visible), plus a photo of the intake/ECU label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown engines/parts (worst case: not guaranteed to match the buyer’s intended model).

risks.risk: Not complete engines (missing key components like starter/alternator, sensors, timing components, wiring harness, ECU).
risks.proof: A photo/video showing one selected engine/assembly fully laid out with all major components present (timing cover area, intake/exhaust manifolds, alternator/starter, ECU/sensors).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/parts-only (worst case: cannot be installed directly).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (bent valves, cracked blocks/heads, water damage, seized internals). Photos only show parts, not test results.
risks.proof: Compression test results or a short video of the engine being cranked/started (if available), or proof of rebuild/inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Quantity/selection risk: the photos show many parts, but not how many usable engines you will receive.
risks.proof: A count/manifest photo: number of complete engines/usable long blocks vs partial parts, with each item tagged.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming the lowest usable quantity (worst case: fewer complete units than expected).

proof_requests: Show one engine/long block clearly from multiple angles, including a close-up of the stamped engine code on the block (or any label).
Confirm whether you are selling complete engines, long blocks, or mixed parts; provide a count of complete units vs partial parts.
Provide proof of condition: compression test, leak-down test, or a video of cranking/starting (if possible).
Provide the exact match to the buyer’s target (RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry) by showing the engine code and year range correspondence.
response.reason: The photos show mixed, disassembled engine parts with no readable engine code/model-year identifiers, so the exact item and condition cannot be priced reliably. Request engine-code/complete-unit proof and working/condition evidence before quoting.
